'''Shanra Immel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]]. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], she served with [[Republic Special Forces Division]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] in a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on [[Kalandis Seven]], a desolate [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Immel and her [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] were tasked with the destruction of the local [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]]. After arriving at the spaceport, Immel, Malcom, and her [[Squad/Legends|squad]] proceeded to take out the [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentries]] and place the first of the [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the spaceport regardless of [[Water/Legends|fog]] cover.

Immel and Malcom then spotted a Sith [[Unidentified planetary command ship|planetary command ship]], and Malcom amended their mission to include him capturing the [[Command ship/Legends|vessel]]. As Malcom went after the Sith [[Starship/Legends|craft]], Immel and her squad placed the last of the beacons at their target sites, and the spaceport was destroyed shortly thereafter. Immel spared a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|starfighter]] to save Malcom's life after he failed to capture the Sith [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Ready to go?''"<br />"''Beacons charged and ready. Plant them on the targets and the fog won't matter&mdash;our fighter wing will know exactly where to drop the payload.|Shanra Immel and Malcom discuss their plan to destroy the local spaceport|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
[[File:Shanra_Immel_and_Jace_Malcom.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sergeant Immel and Colonel Malcom]]
Shanra Immel was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army|Galactic Republic Army]]. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], Immel and her [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] served with [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] of the elite [[Republic Special Forces Division]] on the desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]; Malcom was serving as their [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] there. During the [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|ongoing battle]] for control of the world, Immel and her [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were given orders to destroy the local [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|spaceport]]. On the way to their target, Immel and her squad were attacked, and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was [[Death/Legends|fatally wounded]] during the fighting. After checking Keioidian's condition, Immel made the decision to leave the Corporal behind, activating his [[med tracer]] so that he would be rescued.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

After Immel ordered the squad to move out, the group finally reached the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later. Immel and Malcom emerged from a canyon entering the local plains with the spaceport in sight. After her squad&mdash;consisting of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Camur]], [[Eron (soldier)|Eron]], [[Yennir of the Green]], [[Vaskus Kayle]], [[Min-Reva]], and [[Zenhai]]&mdash;checked in, Malcom gave Immel a satchel of [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the spaceport regardless of [[Water/Legends|fog]] cover. Immel and Malcom approached the spaceport together and observed the enemy patrols. Malcom shot a nearby patrol and, with Immel's help, disposed of their bodies under a half-repaired Imperial fighter.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

Immel discovered that one of the [[Imperial soldier|troopers]] Malcom shot was still alive and killed him to prevent them from being discovered. She then planted one of the target beacons onto a nearby [[power terminal]]. Shortly thereafter, Immel and Malcom sighted a [[Unidentified planetary command ship|planetary command ship]] landing on Kalandis Seven, and Malcom amended Immel's plan to include him capturing the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] alone, while she and her men would finish the mission. Malcom then infiltrated the spaceport and the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]]. Meanwhile, Immel set all the beacons on their targets and checked on Malcom's status.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

In the command [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Malcom fought a female [[Unidentified Sith Overseer|Sith Overseer]] and defeated her, but not before she set off the command ship's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]]. While the spaceport exploded, Immel spared a [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|starfighter]] to save Malcom's life as he jumped out of the stationary Sith craft. Malcom thanked her for saving his life and asked about the status of the mission. She updated him, saying that the spaceport was destroyed, and offered to buy him a [[Alcohol/Legends|drink]], but Malcom declined, stating that he was being recalled to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Mercy shot.|Shanra Immel's thoughts on killing a wounded Imperial soldier|<ref name="TLBoCJM" />}}
Shanra Immel had light skin, short [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. She cared for others, especially those with whom she served, and refused to send them into a situation for which they were not equipped. Immel did not much care for Republic SpecForce and was of the opinion that its members were nothing but scum. When Immel killed a mortally wounded Imperial soldier, she viewed her actions as mercy. She had a disparaging opinion of [[Private/Legends|Private]] Vaskus Kayle, noting that he could not shoot well, and was of the opinion that he would mistakenly [[Poison/Legends|poison]] himself one [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. However, she acknowledged that Kayle recognized his own faults and knew how to follow orders.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Equipment==
She wore red-and-white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was similar to the standard [[Republic trooper]] armor of that [[Time/Legends|time]], and carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shanra Immel first appeared in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story, ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'', which was published in [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]]<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> and released on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
